tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Marsriva MR-US10K-H Energy Efficient 10kVA Online UPS is a high-capacity, enterprise-grade power backup solution designed to deliver continuous, stable, and clean energy for critical infrastructures. Featuring advanced double-conversion online technology, this UPS isolates connected devices from all types of input disturbances—including voltage fluctuation, surges, spikes, harmonic distortion, and electrical noise. With 0ms transfer time, it ensures that servers, network equipment, medical systems, and industrial machinery continue operating without interruption, even during sudden power failures.


Powered by DSP (Digital Signal Processing) control, the MR-US10K-H offers improved efficiency, enhanced voltage regulation, and long-term reliability. Its pure sine wave output and high power factor enable efficient load handling across modern IT and industrial environments. Designed for Bangladesh’s unstable grid conditions, the unit supports a wide input voltage range and intelligent battery management, extending the service life of its battery system. The built-in LCD provides real-time status monitoring, making it easy for IT professionals and engineers to manage power performance in data centers, server rooms, and mission-critical setups. The MR-US10K-H is one of the best heavy-duty UPS solutions for enterprises seeking uncompromised power protection at an affordable price.


Key Features


  • 10kVA High-Capacity Backup – Ideal for data centers, server racks, telecom systems, and industrial machinery
  • True Online Double-Conversion Technology – Ensures complete isolation from power disturbances
  • Zero Transfer Time (0ms) – Prevents reboot or downtime during power failures
  • Pure Sine Wave Output – Suitable for the most sensitive and high-value electronic equipment
  • Advanced DSP Control System – Provides high accuracy, fast response, and improved efficiency
  • Wide Input Voltage Range – Optimized for unstable electrical environments in Bangladesh
  • High Power Factor Output – Delivers more usable power with lower energy loss
  • Intelligent Battery Management – Improves charging efficiency and extends battery lifespan
  • LCD Status Monitoring – Displays voltage, frequency, load, battery status, and system alerts
  • Comprehensive Protection – Short-circuit, overload, surge, overheat, and overcharge protection
  • Heavy-Duty Construction – Designed for enterprise-level reliability and continuous operation
